conditions.description: Filters access by the approvalTarget parameter in the request. TOOL_CALL is an approval for a single agent tool call. PLAN is an approval for a mitigation plan stage or its rollback. Defaults to TOOL_CALL
Filters access by the type of service in the association, such as github, slack, aws or sourceAws. Set by the service from the association's configuration, not supplied by the caller
Filters access by the source AgentSpace ARN on the request. Set by the service from the request context, not supplied by the caller
Filters access by the target AgentSpace ARN on the request. Set by the service from the request context, not supplied by the caller
Filters access by the tags that are passed in the request
Filters access by the tags associated with the resource
Filters access by the tag keys that are passed in the request
